_comment: Freestyle VM settings for real runs. Fill snapshotId after `bun vm/orchestrate.ts snapshot`. Egress domains are UNVERIFIED: confirm each agent's real endpoints before the first run. The model domain (edge key injection) comes from the model profile's baseUrl in config/agents.json, so api.router.com is allowlisted only on Router-model runs.
_builderBaseSnapshot: null = Freestyle's default Ubuntu base. See https://www.freestyle.sh/docs/vms/base-snapshots
_agentEgress: Extra domains each agent may reach (TLS passthrough, no key injection). opencode may try models.dev at startup; add it if the first run shows that.
_factoryKeyMode: env: FACTORY_API_KEY goes on the droid VM (revocable). edge: injected as a Bearer header on agentEgress.droid domains, VM gets a placeholder. edge verified on droid 0.241.1 (smoke run 2026-10-14).
